name: claude-chat-explorer
description: Search your AI agent session history in VS Code: full-text search of every session, including subagents, then resume the session you find.

commands.title: Saropa: Archive Empty and Tiny Sessions
Saropa: Clean Up Sessions (Archive All Except Open)
Saropa: Export Session Digests to Project
Saropa Chats: Open Results in Editor
Saropa Chats: Import Archived Sessions from the Agent

saropaChats.webSessions.enabled.markdownDescription: Show Claude Code Web (cloud) sessions in a Web tab. Uses an unofficial, undocumented Anthropic API with your Claude Code login token (read-only; never stored or logged). It may break or change without notice. Off by default: when off, no network call and no credential read is made.

saropaChats.keepWarm.enabled.markdownDescription: Keep Claude Code sessions warm. Adds a Stop hook to `~/.claude/settings.json` that pings an idle session with a short "warm" reply before the 1-hour prompt cache expires, so the cache is re-read instead of rewritten at the higher write rate. Stops after a run of pings until a real message is sent. Needs Node.js on the PATH. Off by default: when off, the hook is removed and nothing is written. To pause without changing the hook, create `~/.claude/keepwarm.off` (all projects) or `.claude/keepwarm.off` in a project.

saropaChats.showFileSessionsStatusBar.description: Show a status bar count of the sessions that touched the active file.

saropaChats.showUsageStatusBar.description: Show a status bar item with the number of sessions whose context is 80 percent full or more (hidden when there are none). Click it to list those sessions in the panel.

saropaChats.contextWarnings.description: Show a notification when a live session reaches 80 and 90 percent of its context window. The 90 percent notification also offers Copy hand-over note.

saropaChats.maxResults.description: The most sessions listed in search results and in All sessions. Sessions beyond it are still counted, and the panel says so.

saropaChats.openWorkDays.description: How many days of sessions the Project Status page lists. Sessions that are open now are always listed. Archived sessions are left out.

saropaChats.lookupPullRequests.description: Look up open pull requests and their check results (passing, failing, pending) for the Git section of a session card and for the Project Status page, with the gh command (GitHub CLI). This contacts GitHub using your own gh sign-in. Turn it off to never run gh.

saropaChats.autoTitle.enabled.description: Name new Claude Code sessions automatically: an emoji for the topic plus the first sentence of your first prompt, renamed once after your third prompt. Works in the background from the session file; a session you already named yourself is left alone.

saropaChats.autoTitle.useHaiku.description: Let the claude command (Haiku model) write the automatic session title and emoji instead of the rules. Runs in the background and starts a claude process; if it fails, the rule-based title is used. Only applies when automatic titles are on.

saropaChats.digest.auto.description: Rebuild out-of-date session digests in the background: a digest is rebuilt once its session file has not changed for 10 minutes and the session is not running. Starts the claude command (Haiku) when AI parts are on. Off: digests are built only by the Build and Rebuild commands.

saropaChats.digest.useAi.description: Let the claude command (Haiku model) write the goal and the work left open of each session digest, and pick the owner messages that are decisions. Off: a digest holds only the exact parts (dialog answers, files changed, references, dates and branch).

saropaChats.digest.maxAiCallsPerRun.description: Most AI calls (claude command, Haiku model), retries included, that one Build Session Digests run, one Rebuild, or one automatic background pass may make. Once a run reaches it, the remaining sessions get the exact parts only and their AI parts read "not generated" (the next Build retries them). 0 turns AI parts off for every run.

keywords.description: Whole words that choose this emoji; the emoji with the most matches wins.

saropaChats.emojiRules.description: Your own emoji rules for automatic session titles. A rule with the same emoji as a built-in one replaces that one's keywords; other rules are added and win ties.

saropaChats.emojiRulesReplaceDefaults.description: Use only your emoji rules and ignore the built-in ones.

saropaChats.activity.refreshMs.description: How often the Activity panel checks the selected chat for new messages, in milliseconds. Also set from the settings (gear) button on the Activity section header (Slow 1000, Medium 250, Fast 100).

saropaChats.activity.fadeMs.description: How long a flash on the Activity panel takes to fade out, in milliseconds. Also set from the settings (gear) button on the Activity section header (Slow 8000, Medium 4000, Fast 2000).

saropaChats.activity.allChats.description: Follow every live chat on the Activity diagram, not only the chat in the focused tab. Each chat gets its own color (a bar beside its name in the session list and the glow on the diagram). Also set by the All chats checkbox under the settings (gear) button on the Activity section header.

saropaChats.account.hideEmail.description: Hide the email address in the Account block of the Account & Usage section (display only; the account data itself is unchanged). Also set by the Hide account email checkbox under the settings (gear) button on the Account & Usage header.

saropaChats.account.screenShare.description: Screen-share mode for the Account & Usage section: hides the email, name and organization (plan and usage stay). Implies Hide account email. Display only; the account data itself is unchanged. Also set by the Screen-share mode checkbox under the settings (gear) button on the Account & Usage header.

saropaChats.contextRingTokens.description: Each session row shows a small ring that fills as the session's context grows. This is the token count that fills it. The ring turns to the warning color at 80 percent of this number and to the error color at 100 percent or more.

saropaChats.colorDormantMinutes.description: Minutes a session can sit without activity before the colored marker beside its name is hidden in the session list, to reduce visual noise. The color returns as soon as the session is active again. 0 never hides the marker.

saropaChats.search.contextLines.description: How many lines of each matching message (the snippet and the extra matching messages) a search result row shows before cutting it off. Narrow side bars always show one line.

saropaChats.animateDots.description: Animate the session dots: running, waiting and background dots throb, and a session with several states at once (for example background agents and unread) alternates between their colors. Turn it off for still dots that show the most important state; the tooltip lists them all. Dots are also still when your system asks for reduced motion.

colors.description: Session dot: the agent is running.
Session dot: the agent is waiting for you.
Session dot: finished while you were away.
Session dot: waiting on background agents or tasks that are still running.
